Class OnixDebugDraw

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Rendering
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Named, time-expiring debug drawing API. Accessible from any thread. Shapes are buffered by name and auto-rendered. The names are shared for every plugin, you should never use this over proper rendering, this is for quick and dirty debug visualization.

BlockPosFill(string, BlockPos, ColorF, TimeSpan?, string?)

Draw a solid (semi-transparent) bounding box for a single block position in the world.

public void BlockPosFill(string name, BlockPos box, ColorF color = default, TimeSpan? duration = null, string? label = null)

Parameters

name string

Unique identifier. Calling again with the same name updates the entry.

box BlockPos

The block position. Converted to a unit bounding box.

color ColorF

Fill color (rendered at 30% opacity). Defaults to white.

duration TimeSpan?

How long the entry persists. Defaults to 5 seconds.

label string

Optional text label rendered in 3D near the block center.
